F72-SI-401 Flocculant Silo Unload Ready Lamp

ON = UNLOAD READY (permissive for F72-SEQ-0002); OFF = UNLOAD NOT READY
OFF conditions include any of the following:
 - F72-PK-401 E-Stop On
 - LI72001 > A_HH
 - PDI72064 > A_Hi
 - XV72008 OPEN during F72-SEQ-0002 Step 4
ON conditions include the following:
 - none of the OFF conditions are current
 - LI72001 < A_Hi
